question: Under what condition does poison fail to enter the body?
premises: A person may be bitten by great serpents.
Even in that condition, poison does not enter the body.
This is stated as a general result.
inference: Even if bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: Causal basis for this result not stated in this verse
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if bitten by great serpents.
